blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–From lifting her first WTA Tour trophy to grinding her way into the world’s top 15, Alex Eala has had no shortage of memorable moments in 2026. But for the Filipino tennis star, one moment that left a lasting impression did not happen on the many center courts she has played on. Instead, it came during a brief fan interaction at a mall one Friday night in July.
